g.text: A: GOLD against BRONZE; open marker crude, filled marker CEM on the V50 decile, 95% gene-cluster intervals. GOLD / BRONZE sites (gene clusters) under set-B tiers:
P-human domain overlap 211,848 / 324,037 (17,641); P-human conservation 49,939 / 17,477 (7,965); P-human disorder 208,322 / 129,438 (17,144); P-human sequence motif
are listed in Table S5. B: x = max over tier definitions of abs(ln(adjusted / crude)); definitions where the crude and the adjusted interval both exclude the null; y = ln(largest
adjusted / smallest adjusted) over tier definitions whose adjusted interval excludes the null; second value of the labelled point: largest / smallest adjusted estimate after dropping
any estimate whose interval includes the null or has a limit within 0.01 of the null. Secondary axes: the same values as plain ratios. C: open marker crude, filled adjusted; GOLD /
BRONZE sites (gene clusters): all human records 211,848 / 324,037 (17,641 gene clusters); proteins with an abundance value 199,167 / 76,990 (17,079 gene clusters); proteins
with a domain-annotated site 199,302 / 97,200 (16,914 gene clusters); reviewed canonical accessions 199,886 / 77,656 (17,363 gene clusters); all human records, set-A tiers
153,738 / 483,427 (18,434 gene clusters); set-B tiers except where stated.
